CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Spacelens** is an Unraid plugin that shows what is using the space on a disk, pool or share, TreeSize style, with drill-down.
For help, post in the [support thread](https://forums.unraid.net/topic/201144-plugin-spacelens-see-what-uses-space/). Bugs can also be reported on [GitHub](https://github.com/dkarzon/spacelens/issues).
